name: song_f0_rest_threshold_matched_source_model_v1
classifier: StandardScaler then LogisticRegression(C=1.0,class_weight=balanced,max_iter=2000,random_state=0); each arm separately fitted on the same S01/S02 formal windows; no target calibration or hyperparameter choice
scoring: Average window probabilities within a native formal trial; compare paired 4-class macro F1, log loss and Brier on the same S03/S04 trials. No arm selected on target scores.
boundary: One participant and one calendar day; S01/S02/S03 failed collection readiness, S04 previously inspected. This is a retrospective paired local study, not independent or prospective evidence and not a default-model promotion gate.
